summary.manual_initial_frame_observation: All 50 first-frame bottles are visibly cut by the bottom image border; upright20 show upper/body portions, horizontal15 and diagonal15 show limited portions, sometimes a narrow strip. This is qualitative visual review, not a segmentation-derived visibility fraction.
limits: No precise initial object XYZ extracted from source-trial evidence; visual layout agrees with near-table left/right examples, not a per-episode position equivalence proof.
50 head initial frames reviewed, six trajectories sampled at four times each; no all-frame visibility or occlusion ratio.
Wrist views can reveal the bottle in checked examples; complete 50-episode wrist coverage not measured.
Cannot attribute model failures solely to head coverage or infer physical camera calibration.
The 11098 HDF observations exclude 50 raw terminal frames; these terminal poses/images were not audited.
